name: MyTinyTodo
description: Bundled Updater downloads a tar.gz and extracts it over the app with no integrity verification.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The updater downloads the tarball and extracts it over MTTPATH without integrity verification.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | MyTinyTodo | https://github.com/maxpozdeev/mytinytodo | 3f06d51 / 2026-08-02 | Y | N (admin must click "Check for updates" then "Update" in the bundled Updater extension's settings panel) | Y | https (`api.github.com` for version check via `file_get_contents()`; asset `browser_download_url` for the tar.gz — no `verify_peer=>false` or similar found in the stream context) | N | none — downloaded tar.gz is extracted straight over the app directory via shell `tar xzf` with **no hash or signature check** | N/A | `src/ext/updater/class.updater.php:44` (`requestJson()` hits `https://api.github.com/repos/maxpozdeev/mytinytodo/releases`), `:96-108` (`download()` — plain `fopen()`/`file_put_contents()`, no integrity check), `:113-135` (`extractAndReplace()` — `exec("tar xzf ... --strip-components 1 -C $dir")` over `MTTPATH` with zero verification); triggered via `src/ext/updater/class.controller.php` `postCheck()`/`postUpdate()` admin API endpoints |
